thread:
Alex C: Quick async check — status snapshot for Q2 GPU commitments? Need owners + current committed GPU count, procurement ETA, cluster readiness gating items, and any handoffs to SRE. Please ping updates inline. :eyes:

Jin P: Proc update: PO 7821 submitted yesterday to vendor. Vendor acknowledges 60x H100 (80GB) with partial ship: 20 units arriving week of 1765420000, rest in 3 shipments. Customs risk flagged for EU route, estimated +10 days risk. No container issues so far.

Samira K: DC side: racks r04/r05 power capacity OK for 20/20 each, PDUs scheduled for install Mon 09:00. Need floor crew sign-off for cable riser on r05; awaiting facility ticket #FAC-913. Burn-in nodes available starting 3 days after power install.

Priya R: Model side: we need CUDA 12.2 + cuDNN 9 on prod nodes; kernel 6.1 required for optimized kernels. Can we lock driver image for canary nodes? Also request 4 quantization test nodes (4xH100) — tagging request to be added to reservation.

Marta V: Reservation mapping: I need reservation IDs and team tags to allocate. Samira — can you confirm rack+slot IDs once PDUs are in? I'll run the capacity allocation after that. Small helper CLI below to create reservations:
```
# create reservation (example)
redwood reserve --pool dedicated-q2 --gpus=40 --tag=team:ml --until=2026-06-30
```

Jin P: FYI vendor gave tentative manifest numbers: SKU H100-80GB-RED (x60) shipment 1: 20 units (1765420000), ship2: 20 units (1765600000), ship3: 20 units (1765780000). Still working customs clearance plan for EU — shipping via AMS route vs FRA to reduce hold.

Alex C: Ownership clarifications: procurement (Jin) -> vendor comms + manifest; infra (Samira) -> PDUs/rack sign-off + burn-in; SRE (Marta) -> reservation tags + capacity mapping; eng-ml (Priya) -> driver images + quant tests. I'll take rollout coordination with customers. Please confirm within 24h if owners accept.

Samira K: Accepting infra ownership. FAC ticket updated -> FAC-913 assigned to Joel on facilities. PDUs scheduled, cable vendor ETA updated in ticket.

Priya R: Accepting eng-ml ownership. Will queue driver image PR and post CI matrix by tomorrow. Tagging in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/412

Marta V: Accepting SRE. I'll prepare allocation spreadsheet and post reservation IDs here once PDUs are green. Expect first allocations after ship1 arrives + burn-in passes.

Alex C: Blockers: customs risk (Jin) + cable sign-off (Samira) + driver image validation (Priya). Anything else? If not, I'll move this to async weekly sync notes. @Jin P please confirm customs mitigation plan by EOD PST.

deploy-bot: Reservation created: res-1765420001 (staging-reserve, 4 GPUs, tag=team:ml)

Jin P: Confirmed, working customs plan with broker (Est. mitigations: alternate AMS routing + bonded warehouse). I'll post final ETA update by EOD.

Alex C: Thanks all. If anything changes, drop a short note here. :thumbsup:
